articles.title: Pedestrian critically injured after being struck by vehicle in Brampton

Police in Peel Region say the incident occurred just before 9:30 p.m. Saturday in the eastbound lanes of Bovaird Drive, just east of Highway 410. articles.title: ‘Sopranos’ actor Vincent Pastore, known for playing mobsters and tough guys, dead at 80
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Vincent Pastore, a veteran actor who played mobsters and tough guys, and was best known for portraying Salvatore “Big Pussy” Bonpensiero on “The Sopranos,” has died. He was 80.

articles.title: Man dies after assault in May: Hamilton police
articles.summary: Hamilton police say a man has died after he was assaulted in May.

articles.title: Mississauga councillors want to pause data centre builds for a year. Here's why
articles.summary: With data centre builds remaining a hot-topic in Ontario municipalities, some Mississauga city councillors are concerned about the uncertainty surrounding what the centres could mean for the community and the environment.

articles.title: Man charged with 2nd-degree murder in shooting of security guard at Pickering casino
articles.summary: A 20-year-old man is facing a second-degree murder charge in the killing of Michael Ferdinand, who was shot while on the job at Pickering Casino Resort.

articles.title: Caribbean Carnival is back in Toronto for the long weekend. Here's what you need to know
articles.summary: As the annual celebration returns, there will be lots on the go this weekend, including the Grand Parade, which will shut down several downtown roads. Toronto police say they are deploying additional officers for this weekend's festivities, which come weeks after a deadly shooting at another popular cultural festival.

articles.title: Hundreds of casino workers on strike in Ajax, Pickering
articles.summary: About 900 workers from the Casino Ajax and Pickering Casino Resort are on strike after a tentative agreement was struck down by the workers’ union earlier this week.
